description: Shared preview/process contract for auto-Logo resolution. Both the TS resolver in apps/web/src/autoLogo.ts and the Python resolver in packages/kari-core/src/kari_core/processor/renderer.py::_resolve_auto_logo_path must produce the same stem (or null) for every case here. Policy: builtin-only registry, whole-token match, NO fujifilm fallback. Make is normalized through the shared alias table (BRAND_ALIASES / MODEL_PREFIX_ALIASES); an optional `model` participates, and `on_dark` prefers stems carrying the `white` token.

cases.note: multi-token make matches on whole token
unknown brand — V3 does NOT fall back to fujifilm
tokens shorter than 3 chars are discarded
case-preserving stem match (registry order is case-insensitive)
alias: corporate make without shared token
alias: Insta360 bodies report Arashi Vision
model prefix beats the corporate make
alias to olympus; light background avoids the white mark
dark background prefers the white mark
no samsung logo → slot is disabled
